news.headline: Central Florida Sat Nov 28 — NWS Melbourne (1:55 AM): drier, cooler air persists through the weekend, mostly precipitation-free through Sunday afternoon; highs today low to mid 60s north to upper 60s-low 70s south, warming to widespread 70s Sunday; scattered showers return Sunday evening (20-40%), rising Monday (30-50%) and Tuesday (40-70%) as the next front sinks in; river flood warnings remain in effect for the St. Johns River at Cocoa, Geneva, Astor, DeLand and Sanford, all in Major Flood Stage

St. Johns River flooding — Sanford topped its 2022 record Saturday morning: the gauge near Sanford (Lake Monroe) read 8.98 feet at 7:30 AM Sat Nov 28, just above the 8.96-foot record from 2022, with a forecast crest near 9.2 feet around 7 AM Sunday and 9.0-9.2 feet into early next week; DeLand is forecast to crest at 6.6 feet early Tuesday, above its 6.33-foot record, and every gauge from Cocoa to Astor is in major flood stage

Lakeland leads the nation in declining apartment construction — RentCafe/Yardi report (via Business Observer, Nov 27): Lakeland-Winter Haven is on track to add just 1,066 apartments in 2026, down 74.3% from 2025, the steepest drop in the U.S.; Jacksonville fell 72.4% to 2,063 units, while Florida statewide still adds 50,392 units, second only to Texas; nationally 442,395 apartments are expected to open in 2026, down 27% from 2025

Florida's 9th-edition building code takes effect Dec 31, 2026 — the edition in effect on the permit application date governs the work for the life of the permit; the 2026 codes are based on the 2024 International Codes and include the 2023 National Electrical Code, and Miami-Dade portal submissions after 4 PM Dec 30 will be subject to the 2026 edition

Copper surged — LME copper jumped as much as 6.5% intraday to above $12,600 a tonne, its biggest one-day rise since January, as short sellers covered positions; Comex March futures briefly hit $5.76/lb before easing to $5.603/lb

HVAC shipments — AHRI data reported by ACHR News: U.S. shipments of central air conditioners and air-source heat pumps rose 27.3% in September to 673,286 units (central AC up 40.9% to 370,855; heat pumps up 13.8% to 302,431), with year-to-date combined shipments up 7.9% to 7.06 million; gas furnace shipments slipped 0.4% in September and are down 4.4% for the year

Markets — Wall Street closed its best week in more than a year on Fri Nov 27: Dow rose 591.99 points (1.18%) to 50,774.94, S&P 500 gained 1.60% to 7,297.49 and Nasdaq Composite gained 2.31% to 24,129.50; for the week the S&P 500 gained 5.6%, Nasdaq 6.68% and Dow 5.46%; the Fed's pre-meeting quiet period began at midnight today through Dec 10, with futures pricing about a 99% chance of a quarter-point hike at the Dec 8-9 meeting

FHFA Nov 24: the 2027 conforming loan limit for one-unit properties rises to $855,400 in most of the U.S., up $22,650 (2.72%) from 2026, with a high-cost ceiling of $1,283,100 and Monroe County, Florida at $1,035,000; limits will be higher in all but 24 counties, reflecting the rise in average U.S. home values between Q3 2025 and Q3 2026

NBA — Miami Heat beat the New York Knicks 108-105 on Fri Nov 27 at Madison Square Garden in NBA Cup play, eliminating the defending champions from Cup contention; Miami led by as many as 23 points and never trailed until midway through the fourth quarter; the Orlando Magic were knocked out of the Cup despite a 3-1 run; next: Orlando Magic at the Washington Wizards Sat Nov 28 at 5 PM ET, Miami Heat at the Cleveland Cavaliers Sun Nov 29 at 3:30 PM ET

NFL — no Florida team plays Sat Nov 28 and there are no NFL games today; ahead Sun Nov 29 at 1 PM ET: New York Jets at Miami Dolphins (CBS, Hard Rock Stadium) and Tennessee Titans at Jacksonville Jaguars (FOX, EverBank Stadium); Mon Nov 30 at 8:15 PM ET: Carolina Panthers at Tampa Bay Buccaneers (ESPN, Raymond James Stadium)
